## Change

Describe the documentation, example, or image change and why it helps.

## Evidence

For a behavior claim, explain how it was verified. For an image or example,
confirm that it is original or that you have permission to contribute it.

## Checks

- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/check_repository.py`.

- [ ] The change contains no private notes, application source, or credentials.
